question: For the RBAC action access_as_shared, show (1) the top-10 action rows ranked by the subnet IP-version range (max minus min) across referenced subnets with IP version 4 or 6—reporting the action name, average IP version, IP-version range, variance, and whether any referenced subnet has DHCP enabled—and (2) the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version considering only IP version 4 subnets, along with how far each of those IP-version-4 statistics deviates from the overall average of that statistic within the base result set. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    r.id AS rbac_id,
    r.action AS action_name,
    s.ip_version,
    s.enable_dhcp
  FROM networkrbacs r
  JOIN subnets s ON r.object_id = s.network_id
  WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared'
    AND s.ip_version IN (4, 6)
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    rbac_id,
    MAX(action_name) AS action_name,
    AVG(ip_version) AS avg_ip_version,
    MAX(ip_version) - MIN(ip_version) AS ip_version_range,
    VARIANCE(ip_version) AS ip_version_variance,
    MAX(CASE WHEN enable_dhcp = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_dhcp_enabled
  FROM base
  GROUP BY rbac_id
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT * FROM agg ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC LIMIT 10
),
ip4 AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(ip_version) AS avg_ip4,
    VARIANCE(ip_version) AS var_ip4,
    STDDEV(ip_version) AS std_ip4
  FROM base
  WHERE ip_version = 4
),
overall AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(avg_ip_version) AS overall_avg,
    AVG(ip_version_variance) AS overall_var,
    AVG(ip_version_range) AS overall_range
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  t.action_name,
  t.avg_ip_version,
  t.ip_version_range,
  t.ip_version_variance,
  t.any_dhcp_enabled,
  i.avg_ip4,
  i.var_ip4,
  i.std_ip4,
  i.avg_ip4 - o.overall_avg AS avg_deviation,
  i.var_ip4 - o.overall_var AS var_deviation,
  i.std_ip4 - o.overall_range AS std_deviation
FROM top10 t
CROSS JOIN ip4 i
CROSS JOIN overall o
ORDER BY t.ip_version_range DESC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    r.id AS rbac_id,
    r.action AS action_name,
    s.ip_version,
    s.enable_dhcp
  FROM networkrbacs r
  JOIN subnets s ON r.object_id = s.network_id
  WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared'
    AND s.ip_version IN (4, 6)
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    rbac_id,
    MAX(action_name) AS action_name,
    AVG(ip_version) AS avg_ip_version,
    MAX(ip_version) - MIN(ip_version) AS ip_version_range,
    VARIANCE(ip_version) AS ip_version_variance,
    MAX(CASE WHEN enable_dhcp = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_dhcp_enabled
  FROM base
  GROUP BY rbac_id
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT * FROM agg ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC LIMIT 10
),
ip4 AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(ip_version) AS avg_ip4,
    VARIANCE(ip_version) AS var_ip4,
    STDDEV(ip_version) AS std_ip4
  FROM base
  WHERE ip_version = 4
),
overall AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(avg_ip_version) AS overall_avg,
    AVG(ip_version_variance) AS overall_var,
    AVG(ip_version_range) AS overall_range
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  t.action_name,
  t.avg_ip_version,
  t.ip_version_range,
  t.ip_version_variance,
  t.any_dhcp_enabled,
  i.avg_ip4,
  i.var_ip4,
  i.std_ip4,
  i.avg_ip4 - o.overall_avg AS avg_deviation,
  i.var_ip4 - o.overall_var AS var_deviation,
  i.std_ip4 - o.overall_range AS std_deviation
FROM top10 t
CROSS JOIN ip4 i
CROSS JOIN overall o
ORDER BY t.ip_version_range DESC
